caption: The drawing depicts a long, formal coat with a high collar and pointed tails, displayed prominently on the left side of the image. The main body of the coat features a repeating pattern of dark blue-black circular and oval shapes, some resembling stylized fruits or seeds, on a dark gray background. The coat has a faintly reflective quality, suggesting a silky or satin fabric, with accents of deep purple on the inner lining, visible at the front opening, collar, and where the tails part. On the right side of the drawing, there is a smaller black-and-white technical illustration of the same coat, showing the pattern in a simplified form and with the lower tail sections rendered with crosshatching to indicate a different texture or material. The coat is unbuttoned and there are no visible fasteners. The paper background is an off-white or light beige color.
title: Dolman
